hook_description: A building engulfed in flames with thick smoke billowing into the sky as people cling to a high tower.
first_2_seconds_description: Wide view of a burning building emitting thick black smoke, zooming into a telecommunications tower on top.
scene_summary: Real-life footage capturing a serious fire on a commercial building while trapped individuals hold onto an antenna tower above the smoke.
spoken_dialogue_summary: Panicked onlookers speaking Arabic, voicing fear and praying for the safety of people on the tower.
